name: inclusionAI releases LingSante-3.1 medical models under MIT: 560B-A25B flash, 124B-A5.5B air-VL and a 16.7M signal encoder
title: inclusionAI releases LingSante-3.1 medical models under MIT: 560B-A25B flash, 124B-A5.5B air-VL and a 16.7M signal encoder
summary: Ant Group's inclusionAI posted open medical models: a 560B MoE with 1M context in FP8 and MXFP4, a multimodal 124B MoE for imaging and medical GUI workflows, and a small physiological-signal encoder. The lab's own evaluation claims it beats frontier closed models on HealthBench Professional; one builder is already running it on four DGX Sparks.
